purpose: Outcome-blind bounded archival collection diagnostic; not representative, inference, registration, paper observation or funding evidence
selection: Per valid index: all exact Form 4 rows; deduplicate exact references; fail conflicting accession/path metadata; first four unique accessions in ascending accession order, or all if fewer. No substitution for any failure, no-P/S or unresolved identity.
global_stop: Any non200, challenge, transport failure or oversize stops remaining requests; retain attempted/unattempted and exact bounded response bytes. No retries, replacement, extra pages, searches or other dates.
submission_paths: Only index Filename edgar/data/<decimal CIK>/<dashed accession>.txt; preserve exact locator and require accession agreement. Index CIK is filer context, never assumed issuer.
user_agent: Existing ignored SEC_USER_AGENT configuration only; loaded inside request process, never serialized
timing: Preserve transaction, official filing date, raw acceptance, explicit America/New_York interpretation, acceptance+5min assumption, source-derived actionable open and this retrieval separately. First-ever publication/receipt and historical decision availability unknown; no actual decision/entry.
interval: Hypothetical XNYS actionable-open through close of 60th regular session AFTER entry, entry index zero; closed endpoints; sweep opens before closes at equal timestamps. Unknown timing retained separately. No position, NAV, price or dollar capacity.
historical_limit: Indexes and bodies observed in 2026 may reflect corrections/removals; not proof of 2024 archive version, collector completeness or first-public time. Lexical subsample is biased. Unselected means uncollected, never zero events.
